candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a large renal mass in a 27-year-old woman with vascular invasion and pulmonary nodules. While renal cell carcinoma is a common adult renal malignancy, Wilms tumor is a pediatric malignancy. The age of the patient (27 years old) makes Wilms tumor highly unlikely and renal cell carcinoma much more probable. Therefore, the candidate asserts a different, more appropriate, primary tumor type given the patient's age.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Wilms tumor vs. Renal Cell Carcinoma
